notes: South side from La Chambre (Maurienne) on the D213, as in the app (19.2 km, start 472 m, ~8 %). km 0 = La Chambre town centre where the D213 (Route de Saint-Martin) leaves the Grande Rue next to the Place de la Mairie (~473 m in GLO-30); the town-hall square itself is 0.1 km before it. Route: D213 via Saint-Martin-sur-la-Chambre, La Côte, Montoudras, Le Planet, Saint-François-Longchamp (village) and the Saint-François-Longchamp 1650 resort to the col (1993 m, Tour signs 2000 m); a single road except the short residential Chemin de la Fontaine at ~4.3 km, which a router would use to cut the D213 hairpin loop — the point at 4.34 km prevents that. Routed on Overture roads 19.27 km (app 19.2, Wikipedia 19 km / 1522 m); km values = routed distance scaled by 19.2/19.271. The Tour 2025 itinerary counted 19.8 km from its 'La Chambre' point (km 84.8) to the col (km 104.6), i.e. from further back in the valley; the app's 19.2 km fits the town-centre start. Village points are where the D213 passes them (Overture locality positions snapped to the road); hairpin points are on the road. The avalanche gallery (~7.9 km) and the 'demoiselles coiffées' are not mapped as such in Overture and are not used as waypoints.
sources: Overture Maps 2026-10-21.0 transportation segments (D213 Route de Saint-Martin / Route de Saint-François / Route du Col de la Madeleine) and divisions (La Chambre, Saint-Martin-sur-la-Chambre, La Côte, Montoudras, Le Planet, Saint-François-Longchamp, Saint-François-Longchamp 1650)
